faqs.q: What is bamboo water and where does it come from?
faqs.a: Bamboo water (palm wine bamboo water) is a natural sap that forms inside young bamboo culms. This water is collected using the budding technique, then can be consumed directly or distilled for better safety and shelf life.

faqs.q: What are the health benefits of bamboo water?
faqs.a: Based on scientific studies (Journal of Medicinal Plant Research, 2015), bamboo extract has protective antioxidant, anti-inflammatory effects, and supports cardiovascular health. In Nusantara traditional medicine, bamboo water is used to relieve fever, cough and phlegm, improve digestion, help lower blood sugar and cholesterol, and maintain body immunity. Bamboo water is a natural therapy companion — not a doctor's medicine replacement.

faqs.q: Is it safe to consume bamboo water every day?
faqs.a: Yes. Our distilled bamboo water undergoes a gradual distillation process and microbiological quality testing, making it safe for daily consumption. For raw sap (Air Bambu Tabib), we recommend consumption according to therapist or healthcare professional advice.

faqs.q: Can I order bamboo water and bamboo stems in large quantities?
faqs.a: Yes. We serve wholesale and cargo orders — distilled bamboo water in jugs/drums and quality bamboo stems (Petung, Wulung, Apus, Ori) per bundle up to per truck, with delivery to all provinces in Indonesia.

faqs.q: What types of bamboo are available?
faqs.a: We provide Petung/Betung bamboo (Dendrocalamus asper) for construction, Wulung (black) bamboo for premium aesthetics and crafts, Apus bamboo for ropes and weaving, and Ori bamboo for lightweight frames. All are selected from 3+ years, straight, and evenly dried.

faqs.q: How to order and how long is the delivery time?
faqs.a: You can order through the form on this website, WhatsApp, or sales email. Regular orders for Jabodetabek & West Java 1–3 business days; outside Java 3–7 business days depending on location and volume. Large shipments use a trusted cargo fleet.

faqs.q: Is PT Bambu Water Nusantara a legal entity?
faqs.a: Yes, we are an official Limited Liability Company (Perseroan Terbatas) with a registered founding deed — supported by founders, a complete board of commissioners and directors, an operational management division, and a multidisciplinary expert board that oversees production quality.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Distilled Bamboo Water and Air Bambu Tabib?
faqs.a: Distilled Bamboo Water is bamboo sap purified through gradual distillation — safe for daily consumption with a longer shelf life. Air Bambu Tabib is fresh raw sap directly from the bamboo culm, harvested using traditional techniques for therapeutic, tabib, and complementary medicine practices.

faqs.q: Can bamboo water replace doctor's medicine?
faqs.a: No. Bamboo water is a natural therapy beverage that complements a healthy lifestyle, not a medicine. For specific medical conditions such as diabetes, hypertension, or kidney disease, always consult your doctor or healthcare professional before making bamboo water part of your health program.

faqs.q: Do you serve shipping outside Java Island?
faqs.a: Yes, we deliver to all 38 provinces in Indonesia — Sumatera, Kalimantan, Sulawesi, Bali & Nusa Tenggara, Maluku, to Papua — via a network of land, sea, and air cargo with safe packing for long-distance shipping.
